He doesn't just focus on 'how to make it work', but on 'how to prevent it from failing', contemplating a thousand possible scenarios, even the most improbable ones. faq.question: What is the core difference between a Senior Frontend Engineer and a Frontend Architect?
faq.answer: A Senior Frontend Engineer excels at implementing complex features and components with high craft. A Frontend Solutions Architect designs the systemic foundations for entire organizations: defining module boundaries, establishing design token pipelines, enforcing performance budgets, creating testing strategies, and setting the technical standards that enable multiple engineering squads to build in parallel without stepping on each other.

faq.question: When does a product organization need a dedicated Frontend Architect?
faq.answer: An organization typically requires a Frontend Architect when scaling beyond 2-3 engineering teams, when splitting a legacy frontend monolith into micro-frontends or shared libraries, when adopting a company-wide Design System, when facing Core Web Vitals or bundle bloat regressions, or when transitioning team workflows to leverage modern AI-assisted engineering with strict quality control.

faq.question: How do you ensure web performance and Core Web Vitals remain optimal in production?
faq.answer: Performance cannot be an afterthought; it is built into the architecture. I implement zero-runtime CSS strategies, critical CSS inlining, font display optimization, strict chunk splitting, payload budgets, and automated Lighthouse CI checks in every pull request. In production, real-user monitoring (RUM) telemetry tracks 75th-percentile vitals to detect regressions before users do.

faq.question: What is your approach to building and scaling Design Systems?
faq.answer: I build Design Systems starting with a single source of truth in design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, elevations) decoupled from specific frameworks. On top of tokens, we build headless, fully accessible primitives (using tools like Reka UI or PrimeVue), styled with modern Tailwind CSS variants. This ensures brand consistency, rapid theming, and bulletproof accessibility across all client apps.

faq.question: How do you integrate AI into engineering workflows without compromising software quality?
faq.answer: We treat AI as a powerful execution amplifier under strict human architectural governance. All AI-augmented code generation must adhere to established design patterns, undergo human peer review, and pass 100% of automated lint, typecheck, coverage, and end-to-end Playwright test suites. The human architect designs the seams and contracts; AI accelerates the delivery.

faq.question: Which tech stacks and ecosystems do you specialize in?
faq.answer: My primary stack centers on Vue 3 (Composition API with script setup, TypeScript), Nuxt 4, Nitro server routes, Tailwind CSS v4, and modern Node.js/Vite tooling. I also have deep production experience with Angular (v16+), TypeScript microservices, Web Components, and edge cloud architectures.
